PAINTING & BODYWORK · Body Repair

Body & Collision Repair in Riyadh

Collision and body repair for premium vehicles in Riyadh: structural assessment, panel repair and refinishing at QSC's dedicated painting & bodywork facility.

  1. Home
  2. Painting & Bodywork
  3. Body & Collision Repair

After a collision, the visible dent is the least important part of the assessment. Modern luxury bodies mix steels, aluminium and bonded structures that absorb energy in designed ways — so the first question is always what the impact did beneath the surface. QSC's body repair begins with structural assessment and measurement where indicated, separates what must be replaced from what can be properly repaired, and finishes with refinishing that stands up to inspection.

When to book this service

  • Collision damage — from a parking knock to a serious accident
  • Panel gaps that changed, doors or boot that no longer close cleanly
  • Visible deformation, cracked paint lines or misaligned trim after an impact
  • An insurance or private repair you want done to a high standard

How QSC handles it

Damage assessment including structure behind the visible panels

Chassis measurement where the impact pattern calls for it

Repair or replacement of affected panels and components to a defined scope

Refinishing, reassembly, panel-gap setting and final inspection

Frequently asked questions

Do you work with insurance claims?

Bring your claim details to the assessment; the team will tell you plainly how the process works with your insurer and what documentation the workshop provides.

The damage looks small. Do I really need an assessment?

Small visible damage can hide displaced structure, broken clips or sensor mounts — especially on bumpers packed with radar and cameras. A quick assessment is how you find out whether it really is small.

Will the repaired area be noticeable?

The goal of proper body repair is that it is not — correct panel repair, paint matching and finishing exist for exactly that reason. Where any limitation exists for your specific damage, you are told before the work, not after.
